changeSet.author: gboyeguntaiwo
changeSet.comment: LV3-1965 Flow A2: Sync HTS module records (pmtct_hts = false) to PMTCT pregnancy cycles for clients who entered via ANC. Updates observation JSONB column to add pmtctCycleUuid field. Scoped to Setting contains 'ANC' and dateOfVisit on or before ANC enrollment date.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter h SET observation = jsonb_set( h.observation, '{pmtctCycleUuid}', to_jsonb(pc.uuid::text), true ) FROM pmtct_anc a INNER JOIN pmtct_pregnancy_cycle pc ON a.pmtct_cycle_uuid = pc.uuid WHERE h.archived = false AND h.pmtct_hts = false AND h.observation->>'pmtctCycleUuid' IS NULL AND CAST(h.patient_uuid AS TEXT) = a.patient_uuid AND a.archived = false AND ( UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'facilitySetting', '')) LIKE '%ANC%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'communityEntryPoint', '')) LIKE '%ANC%' ) AND h.date_of_visit <= a.date_of_enrollment;

rollback.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter h SET observation = h.observation - 'pmtctCycleUuid' FROM pmtct_anc a WHERE h.archived = false AND h.pmtct_hts = false AND h.observation->>'pmtctCycleUuid' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(h.patient_uuid AS TEXT) = a.patient_uuid AND a.archived = false AND ( UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'facilitySetting', '')) LIKE '%ANC%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'communityEntryPoint', '')) LIKE '%ANC%' ) AND h.date_of_visit <= a.date_of_enrollment;

changeSet.author: pmtct-team
changeSet.comment: LV3-1965 Flow A2b: Sync HTS module records (pmtct_hts = false) to PMTCT pregnancy cycles for clients who entered directly via Labour & Delivery (no prior ANC). Updates observation JSONB column to add pmtctCycleUuid field. Scoped to Setting contains 'L&D' and dateOfVisit on or after delivery date.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter h SET observation = jsonb_set( h.observation, '{pmtctCycleUuid}', to_jsonb(pc.uuid::text), true ) FROM pmtct_delivery d INNER JOIN pmtct_pregnancy_cycle pc ON d.pmtct_cycle_uuid = pc.uuid WHERE h.archived = false AND h.pmtct_hts = false AND h.observation->>'pmtctCycleUuid' IS NULL AND CAST(h.patient_uuid AS TEXT) = d.patient_uuid AND d.archived = false AND ( UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'facilitySetting', '')) LIKE '%L&D%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'communityEntryPoint', '')) LIKE '%L&D%' ) AND h.date_of_visit >= d.date_of_delivery;

rollback.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter h SET observation = h.observation - 'pmtctCycleUuid' FROM pmtct_delivery d WHERE h.archived = false AND h.pmtct_hts = false AND h.observation->>'pmtctCycleUuid' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(h.patient_uuid AS TEXT) = d.patient_uuid AND d.archived = false AND ( UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'facilitySetting', '')) LIKE '%L&D%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(h.observation->>'communityEntryPoint', '')) LIKE '%L&D%' ) AND h.date_of_visit >= d.date_of_delivery;
